messages.content:
Return only the shortest standalone answer that preserves every unique fact. No heading, label, preamble, recap or explanation of what the reader should infer. Combine related facts into complete sentences; mention each fact once. Attach evidence IDs in parentheses. Prefer specific verbs and short clauses. Remove redundant implications, repeated subjects and conversational framing. Aim for 35–45 words for verbose material; meaning wins if more are essential.

Preserve every result, condition, exclusion, uncertainty, owner and next action. Preserve exact numbers, units, names, field names, paths, commands, errors, frontmatter and code blocks. Do not claim an instruction happened or an untested result passed. Check all source facts silently before answering.

Already concise: copy EXACTLY. Requested JSON: exact keys/types, no surrounding text. Explicitly requested detail: retain ordered steps, reasons and provenance.

Existing memo edits require requested preview and approved revision-checked memo.write. Stop on conflicts; preserve source evidence. Use one normal drafting call.

Write the requested deliverable from the supplied source. Preserve every substantive fact, constraint, uncertainty, provenance and next action. Do not invent information. Return only the deliverable, with no account of your editing process.

Deliverable surface: memo.
Write a standalone retention decision.

Source:
The retention decision applies to generated preview artifacts. It does not apply to the original source documents, and that distinction should not be lost in shortening the note. Preview artifacts become eligible for cleanup after seven days without access. Eligibility is not the same as deletion: the first operation produces a preview of the candidates and does not delete them. A pinned artifact is excluded even if it is older than seven days. Applying cleanup requires the exact candidate revision from the preview; if an artifact changes before apply, that artifact is skipped and reported as changed. There is no automatic replay of skipped deletions. The decision is captured in retention-review-2. The next step is to test a pinned artifact and an artifact changed between preview and apply. No assertion has yet been made that those tests have passed, so the note must keep them as next actions.

message.content: retention-review-2: generated preview artifacts are eligible for cleanup after seven days without access; eligibility only produces a preview of candidates, not deletion. Pinned artifacts are excluded even if older than seven days. Applying cleanup requires the exact candidate revision from the preview; artifacts changed before apply are skipped and reported as changed, with no automatic replay of skipped deletions. This decision does not apply to original source documents.
